nodes.label: The Tower — Lambda_9 to Lambda_13
nodes.rationale: Four axes above the ninth return not five facts about five coordinates but one law met five times and a shape that survives it; each coordinate must be a physical degree of freedom no function of the coordinates below it can express.

nodes.label: Lambda_9 Composes — A Category of Transitions
nodes.rationale: Lambda_8's source has four coordinates and its target three, so its output is not a legal input and it cannot be iterated; 2S' <= g makes all 1,654 targets legal sources, and composition transferring min(q_a, q_b) is closed over 41,682 pairs with zero failures and is associative.

nodes.label: Composability as a Third, Stricter Grading
nodes.rationale: Composability is lost at axis 10, one step before exactness is, because v is a counting coordinate that closes exactly yet has no source counterpart: an axis can be exact and not composable, none is composable and not exact, so Lambda_9 sits alone at the top.

nodes.label: The Dichotomy — Counting Closes Exactly, Coupling Closes as an Envelope
nodes.rationale: Pauli, the hydrogenic solution and counting give single-coordinate exact bounds, which is why E(Lambda) = 0 was available at all; vector coupling's exact form is made of the three excluded shapes, so the price of certainty is paid per coupling axis rather than once at the door. The surplus is not waste: every envelope cell is a tripwire.

nodes.label: A Bound From the Law, or a Bound From the Extent
nodes.rationale: Axes 9 and 10 take bounds from laws independent of Lambda; axis 11 takes its bound from Lambda's own extent, which is why exactness is lost exactly there. Since R builds bounds from a set's own projections, E(X) is the price of describing a set by its extent rather than its law, and E(X) = 0 says the extent IS the law — self-reference stated as arithmetic.

nodes.label: The Third Excluded Form — Symmetric Bounds
nodes.rationale: The exact ceiling of every coupling axis is symmetric under particle-hole conjugation, and a symmetric non-constant function is not monotone, so the admissible form cannot carry it; the envelope gap decomposes into reflection, congruence and triangle, and no coupling axis escapes all three.

nodes.label: Precision Is Path-Dependent; Physics Is Not
nodes.rationale: The exact J-set is the same through K or directly (12 of 12 pairs) but the envelopes differ, 64.4% against 39.4%: the envelope does not commute with recoupling, so the index remembers the route and the atom does not.

nodes.label: The K Bound — The Tree or the Tightness
nodes.rationale: The exact law for K has two parents, one on each side of the cylinder — the first bridge other than q — and breaks factorisation by 15,150 cells at Lambda_12 and 45,450 at Lambda_13. The one-parent form using f_max is taken instead, preserving tree and cylinder at the cost of admitting slightly more than the law does below the cap.

nodes.label: The E1 Index Whose One Prediction Is False
nodes.rationale: Removing J = 0 -> 0 breaks closure by exactly four meets, all the same forbidden cell, so E = 1 and the single restored cell is the one the atom vetoes. This is the calibration the book owes on what E measures: E(X) counts proposals, not guarantees, and reporting the one thing it cannot see is the method working.
